parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority must maintain proper accounts and other relevant records and prepare an annual statement of accounts in the form prescribed by the Central Government.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Authority maintains proper accounts and prepares annual statements in the prescribed form.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Authority under the TRAI Act 1997.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to record-keeping and financial reporting requirements.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority must submit its accounts and audit report to the Central Government annually.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Authority submits its certified accounts and audit report to the Central Government annually.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Authority under the TRAI Act 1997.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation mandates the submission of financial records to the Central Government.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority must prepare an annual report summarizing its activities and forward copies to the Central Government.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Authority prepares and forwards an annual activity report to the Central Government.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Authority under the TRAI Act 1997.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires the preparation and submission of an annual activity report.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority must furnish returns and statements to the Central Government as required.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Authority provides returns and statements to the Central Government as directed.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Authority under the TRAI Act 1997.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation mandates the submission of returns and statements to the Central Government.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority must allow the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India to audit its accounts at specified intervals.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Authority allows the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India to audit its accounts at specified intervals.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Authority under the TRAI Act 1997.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires the Authority to permit audits by the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority must ensure that the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India has the rights and privileges to conduct audits.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India has the necessary rights and privileges to conduct audits.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Authority under the TRAI Act 1997.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that the auditor has the authority to conduct audits.
